20.name: Sofia's paranoia
20.overview: Christmas break is over and Sofia and August return to class as ex-boyfriends. But Sofia is nervous that Coco and August are up to something. Sara and Leonora help with lip-reading from a distance, but does it really help Sofia's paranoia?

20.name: Everyone loves my dad
20.overview: Daniel has finally made captain of the school's soccer team and the timing is perfect because his dad is finally home to watch the game. But Daniel's dad isn't quite as impressed as Daniel had hoped.

20.name: New seats
20.overview: The class needs new seats after the holidays, and Frede and Filippa have to sit next to each other. But Filippa is really mad at Frede! He doesn't understand and tries to win Ines and Mimi's trust, because they might be the way to become friends with Filippa?

20.name: Is Liva flirting with... Jakob?
20.overview: Vester sees Liva trying to flirt with Jakob. He convinces Jakob that Liva is crazy about him! But does Jakob reciprocate her feelings? And how does he make the leap from being Liva's friend to being Liva's... flirt?

20.name: Ruben under indictment
20.overview: Turid has discovered that someone has been graffitiing the school. She's sure that Ruben is the culprit! But Ruben insists he didn't do the graffiti... but then who did? And how can he find out who committed the vandalism - and prove it?

20.name: August alone in the world
20.overview: August doesn't know who to hang out with at recess. Oskar is at the doctor's office and August isn't really on speaking terms with Sofia after their breakup - and she's with Coco all the time. He ends up playing soccer and has to kick ass. But it doesn't feel right at all.

20.name: Locked inside
20.overview: Daniel and Ruben are still enemies after the fight. And it feels like the cruelest punishment in the world when Christoffer puts them together as puppets. It's impossible for the guys to work together.

20.name: The diary thief
20.overview: Ines forgets her diary when she talks to Frede and he is tempted to know her innermost thoughts. He manages to stop himself from reading it - but then it suddenly disappears and a mysterious insta-profile appears,

20.name: Chatbot Crush
20.overview: Pixie has fallen in love with a Troy Bolton chatbot, but tries to keep it hidden. Liva discovers this and shares her concerns with Vester. They try to help Pixie, but it's difficult without seeming judgmental.

20.name: Sole Mates
20.overview: Daniel has spent six months saving up for the coolest sneaks, and FINALLY he can flex them in class. But it turns out he's not the only one with new shoes... Morgan and Bob bought the exact same shoes and want to start a shoe club.

20.name: Pink Pony Club
20.overview: There's an art theme in the club and Vester has requested a dance for him and Jakob. Jakob isn't too excited about it, especially when he realizes that they have to dance in front of the WHOLE club... and in costumes to boot!

20.name: Ines hates Valentine's Day
20.overview: All the girls are excited about Valentine's Day, except Ines. She thinks it's a ridiculous concept and wants to cancel the day - and she gets Mimi on board. But in reality, Mimi strongly disagrees with Ines. How does she get her say?

20.name: Coco's new friends
20.overview: Sofia fangirles over the older girls, Cleo and Esther, which Coco finds super cringeworthy. But what happens to Sofia and Coco's friendship when Coco suddenly ditches Sofia and starts hanging out with Cleo and Esther?

20.name: The Wild West
20.overview: Vester and Jakob go to war with Asger and Bjørn as they compete to play the lead roles in Liva's new movie. Which pair will win this crazy battle?

20.name: Tiny Bob
20.overview: Bob is tired of always ending up in the goal when the boys play soccer. He feels he's always overlooked because he's small. KlubRas tries to help and organizes a limbo competition where being small is a huge advantage!

20.name: Do I have ADHD?
20.overview: Liva dreams of being able to say bye-bye to fractions and avoid math altogether, so when she discovers that Asger gets a pass because he has ADHD, she starts to investigate whether the symptoms don't also apply to her.

20.name: Emmy's desert island
20.overview: Rebekka and Sonja have organized a nail night without inviting Emmy. She feels left out, even though she doesn't care about doing nails at all. She tries to convince the girls that she's also interested in nails, but it goes horribly wrong.

20.name: Obsessed with being perfect
20.overview: Sofia doesn't feel good, good-looking or pretty enough and tries to avoid changing with Coco and the other girls at PE. But suddenly there's a magical cleaning lady in the changing room who tries to convince Sofia that she's perfect just the way she is.

20.name: Ines goes viral
20.overview: Mimi and Ines make a silly dance video and Ines explicitly asks Mimi not to share the video with others. Can Mimi keep her promise or will Ines suddenly go viral?

20.name: On a date with Aske
20.overview: Liva sends an invite to a movie night, but accidentally sends the text to Aske instead of Jakob and Vester. So now Aske thinks they're going on a date! How does Liva get out of the date - and can her friends Jakob and Vester help her with their always "brilliant" ideas?

20.name: The battle for Ruben
20.overview: Daniel and Ruben are finally best friends again. But Daniel is so afraid of losing his friend that he doesn't want to share Ruben with anyone, even at the club. Will it end in conflict again?

20.name: Big truancy day
20.overview: Jakob and Vester are having the hottest truancy day and decide to pull a prank. But the prank leads them back to school... where a cruel surprise awaits them!

20.name: Committing burglary
20.overview: KlubRas informs Sonja, Emmy and Rebekka to hand in their phones so they can be locked up while the girls are at the club. Under great protest, they hand over their phones.

20.name: Is Oskar BETA?
20.overview: Bob and Morgan tell Oskar that even though Leonora and Sara laugh at him when he's being silly and funny, it means that the girls don't really respect him. Oskar searches for answers and watches a bunch of videos that Bob sends.

20.name: Get paid to read
20.overview: Vester's parents want him to read more books in his spare time, so they pay him half a penny per page read! What his parents don't know is that he only reads easy-to-read children's books with large print and very few words on each page.

20.name: In love with the wrong person
20.overview: Sofia can't get over August and when she decides to win him back, Coco supports the project. They arrange an eye contact exercise, but when Coco ends up sitting across from August, she suddenly feels a budding emotion.

20.name: Frede's grandfather
20.overview: Frede is looking forward to seeing his grandfather, but Ines and Mimi tell him about their dead grandparents - and Frede feels a sudden fear that his grandfather may not have many days left either. What if something happens to grandpa?

20.name: Vester's dirty power struggle
20.overview: Pixie wants to continue on the school's activities committee, but Vester rebels and arranges for Jakob to run against her. Vester acts as a spin doctor and he will stop at nothing. He ends up rolling over Pixie, who is deeply hurt...

20.name: Rubens star
20.overview: Bob and Morgan jokingly use 'Jew' as an insult, which makes Filippa angry. Even more so when she finds out that Ruben is actually Jewish. Ruben wants to keep a low profile, but realizes that she's right and he needs to speak up.

20.name: Bet it all
20.overview: Oskar has heard that Coco is crazy about August and tries to convince August to declare his love for her. Even though August IS crazy about Coco, he doesn't dare do anything about it because she has already rejected him once.

20.name: Cuddly darlings
20.overview: Turid loves Ines and Ines loves to be praised by Turid. But when Asger and Bjørn call her a pet, Ines decides to get rid of her role as the teacher's favorite student. Will Ines succeed in rebelling?

20.name: The school's secret treasure
20.overview: Liva wants to avoid appearing childish to the other students at school... but Vester certainly doesn't help when he shows up as Dennis in his cowboy hat. Jakob and Vester manage to lure Liva on a mission anyway - does she realize that this might be a bad idea?

20.name: Useless
20.overview: Sonja fears she'll have to repeat a grade because she feels like she's always doing badly in school. When she finally feels like she's put a lot of effort into an assignment, she gets it back from Tara full of comments.

20.name: BFF Break-up
20.overview: Sofia tries to be inclusive and accept that Coco and August are dating. But it's not that easy. At the same time, she constantly feels rejected by Coco, who would rather spend time with August than Sofia. Does she have to break up with her best friend?

20.name: Oskar's good glow
20.overview: Overnight, Oskar has become very tan. He's been using self-tanner, but when August compliments his tan, he's embarrassed to care about his appearance - and doesn't want to admit that his great tan is due to self-tanner.

20.name: What's going to happen to us?
20.overview: The class is visited by coach Philip, who talks about the importance of making good future plans for yourself. Jakob, however, has no idea what he wants to do with his future. How does he choose which path to take when anything is possible?

20.name: Scandalous interview - Part 1
20.overview: The class is interviewing each other and Filippa and Ruben will be working together. Filippa is nervous because she really wants to get to know Ruben much better, and the interview might help her do just that... but he ends up disappointing her anyway.

20.name: Scandalous interview - Part 2
20.overview: Ruben gets awkward every time he tries to impress Filippa. And now he's not only made her really upset, but she's also really angry with him. It wasn't meant to be! How could it go so wrong? And can he ever make it right?

20.name: Who is Coco?
20.overview: When the class is asked to write about who each of them is, Coco is struck with doubt. Who is she really? She's no longer friends with Sofia, but is she just August's girlfriend?

20.name: Fun, funnier, funniest
20.overview: Liva has to decide which of Jakob and Vester is funnier. Having to choose between her two friends isn't easy - so... can she cheat them and avoid having to choose?

20.name: Plaster at first sight
20.overview: Frede helps Emmy after a bike crash and is hailed as a hero. She has a cast on her arm and everyone wants to write on it, but Frede doesn't dare. He's ashamed of his handwriting and secretly tries to improve it. Why does he want to make an impression so badly?

20.name: The princes of prepping
20.overview: Vester and Jakob have converted a secret closet at school into a food warehouse. All they hear about on the news is the importance of prepping. But someone is stealing from their pantry... Is the thief an enemy or an ally?

20.name: Ines-cape room
20.overview: The new middle school students are going to be shown around, and the class is tasked with organizing something fun for them. Ines has a plan ready for an escape room, but Mimi and the other girls aren’t quite as keen on the idea.

20.name: Cold air
20.overview: Ruben and Filippa aren't speaking to each other after the interview incident. Filippa is still furious with Ruben, and Daniel can't stand to see his friend suffering. He realizes he has to step in and help smooth things over, so he decides to play matchmaker.

20.name: We're heading to Hansa Park
20.overview: Vester and Jakob have been on the school patrol all year and are now close to reaping the rewards and going on the annual trip to Hansa Park. On his last day on duty, however, Vester comes down with a fever and feels sick, but he refuses to call in sick.

20.name: Fries and guys
20.overview: Filippa has kissed Ruben, and she’s really excited to share the news with her friends—until she finds out that Ines has completely different plans for their summer: she wants to ban all talk of boys!

20.name: Goodbye again?
20.overview: Coco’s mom is offered a job in Paris, and Coco is getting ready to leave again. Will she have to break up with August? Or can they stay together even if Coco lives in Paris?

20.name: One last chance
20.overview: August is feeling absolutely down in the dumps after Coco broke up with him. But when he finds out that she isn't going to Paris after all, he regains his hope. He has to give it another shot—maybe love will get one last chance?

21.name: The Gossip Wall
21.overview: Summer vacation is over, and a new school year is kicking off in the class. But the first day of school after vacation isn’t without its drama, of course - because someone has covered an entire wall with rumors, secrets, and gossip about everyone in the class. Who’s behind it?

21.name: What if it's true?
21.overview: Jonas and Sylvester are blamed for creating the gossip wall, and Michael forces them to clean it off. But what should Jonas do if what’s written on the wall is actually true - that Lily has a crush on him?

21.name: Uma's Glow-Up
21.overview: Uma's best friends Axel and Buster are blown away by her new style, which is suddenly much more feminine. What happened during the summer holidays?

21.name: Embarrassing Per
21.overview: Per has his first day in class. At his previous school he was labeled an outsider. That's why he tries his best to avoid being associated with the nerds, but will he succeed in becoming part of the popular boys?

21.name: Drama in Roblox
21.overview: Winston is the best gamer in the class. But his position is threatened when Carlo discovers that there’s an unknown player on the class server who’s just as skilled - and maybe even… better? Winston MUST find out who this unknown gamer is!

21.name: In Love with a Teacher
21.overview: Madison is completely and utterly done with guys! That is, until a new, young, and handsome teaching assistant shows up at school. Can Maddi win him over?

21.name: Kaya Returns
21.overview: Kaya has been away from class, and Liv misses her very much. That’s why Liv is happy when Kaya suddenly returns. But when Liv pretends that nothing has happened, in an effort to make things easier for Kaya, Kaya ends up feeling ignored instead.

21.name: Last one chosen
21.overview: Per is afraid of being picked last when it's time to divide up teams for gym class. But AK and Cille have come up with their own rules that make gym class... fun?

21.name: Secrets
21.overview: Axel and Buster want to impress Uma, so they suggest playing "Pandora's Box." Uma also has something she's kept to herself for a long time, and she'd like to share it with the boys.

21.name: An Invisible Prank
21.overview: Carlo shows up at school, even though he had actually told his friends he was going to a summer house. Winston and Marcus therefore decide to play a prank on him by pretending he isn't there. At first it's fun, but eventually Winston takes it too far.

21.name: Mikkel's Little Lies
21.overview: Mikkel tends to exaggerate a little. I wonder if all his lies will one day get him into real trouble?

21.name: Cille is moving
21.overview: Cille and A.K. have always lived in the same building, but Cille has been told she has to move. How on earth is she going to break the news to A.K.?

21.name: Nature therapy?
21.overview: The class needs to get out into nature a bit. Michael is organizing an activity for the class that might help Uma reconnect with her former best friends, Buster and Axel.

21.name: Winston's Looksmaxxing
21.overview: Winston and Marcus start working on their looks, and when Liv and Sia invite them to a girls’ night, they think their efforts have already paid off and that the girls are crazy about their looks! But are they really?

21.name: Buster vs. Axel
21.overview: Buster and Axel are still competing against each other for Uma's attention. Who will win?

21.name: AI Drama
21.overview: Jonas gets back at Madison, who blames him for the gossip wall. He tricks Per into making an AI video, but it goes completely wrong! What will the consequences be?

21.name: The Lie About Confirmation
21.overview: Kaya is going to lie to the rest of the class and say she's planning a wild party for her confirmation. The truth is, she isn't even getting confirmed, and Winston is going to expose her lie.

21.name: Can Jonas win Lily over?
21.overview: Jonas has been checking out Lily for a long time. Sylle has found a guidebook that has all the right advice on how Jonas can win Lily over!

21.name: The Woman in the Dark
21.overview: Uma drops her hair clip into a grate, but her friends are too scared to ask the janitor for help because there are rumors that she’s super creepy. Uma is determined to get her clip back and is extremely surprised when she runs into the dreaded janitor!

21.name: Did Lily make the gossip board?
21.overview: A.K. and Cille begin to suspect that Lily might be behind the gossip wall. They invite her to join their secret game club so they can spy on her and gather evidence!

21.name: Uma's little brother
21.overview: Axel and Buster offer to babysit Uma's little brother to make a good impression. But they panic when they lose him—what will Uma say?

21.name: Never have I ever...
21.overview: Jonas isn't paying attention to Lily anymore, and she misses his attention. Madison convinces Lily that Jonas is trying to manipulate her. They arrange for the class to play "Never have I ever" so they can get him to admit it.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Never have I ever...
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Jonas isn't paying attention to Lily anymore, and she misses his attention. Madison convinces Lily that Jonas is trying to manipulate her. They arrange for the class to play "Never have I ever" so they can get him to admit it.

overview: What is happening in the class? Who are friends, who are enemies - and who has had a mishap? The pupils have yet another day ahead of them.
title: Klassen
